lead_fa: Marksmanship شلیک‌های سنگین و بُرد بلند است: Aimed Shot و Rapid Fire روی کول‌داون، بعد از هرکدام یک خرج‌کنندهٔ Precise Shots. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Sentinel]] که با تنظیم فعلی برای همهٔ حالت‌ها بهینه است و [[Dark Ranger]] با [[Black Arrow]] و بازی پروک-محور.

strengths: Excels at burst AoE: hard-limited to 8 targets but reaches some of the highest peak numbers on those counts in the game
Fairly mobile: ahead of most other ranged specs, able to cast a significant part of the rotation on the move
weaknesses: Longer cast times outside cooldowns reduce target-swap flexibility and out-of-cooldown burst

changes_12_1.note: Unload is gone in 12.1.5 and Blood Fletching takes its place.

hero.recommendation: Sentinel is optimal for all scenarios with current tuning.
hero.sentinel: Passive effects (Sentinel, Moonlight Chakram, Lunar Storm) that do not significantly change gameplay: essentially core Marksmanship with a smooth, predictable flow. Offers passive durability.
hero.dark_ranger: Black Arrow replaces Kill Shot and is usable far more often; significantly more Deathblow procs from various sources; highly proc-focused and reactive.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Marksmanship Hunter Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/hunter/marksmanship/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Core loop: Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire on cooldown; both activate Precise Shots which heavily buff Arcane Shot / Kill Shot / Black Arrow; follow each with a PS Spender.
Add Explosive Shot and Volley on cooldown; Steady Shot is the filler when nothing else is available.
Only one notable cooldown: Trueshot (crit chance and damage buff).

st_sentinel: Use on-use trinkets inside Trueshot; stat trinkets gain the most from the window
Explosive Shot on cooldown; with Unstable Trigger cast it twice in a row
Trueshot on cooldown; save the fight's final use until Bullseye reaches 30 stacks
Moonlight Chakram once Trueshot has roughly 5 seconds left
During Trueshot, cast Aimed Shot when you have no Precise Shots
Rapid Fire on cooldown if you have no Precise Shots to spend, or while Trueshot is up
Kill Shot to spend Precise Shots
Arcane Shot to spend Precise Shots
aoe: Explosive Shot on cooldown; the two Unstable Trigger casts should go on two different targets so the 4-set reduces cooldowns twice (unless a priority target is up)
Trueshot on cooldown (final use at 30 Bullseye stacks)
Moonlight Chakram if Trueshot is about to expire
Multi-Shot to spend Precise Shots or refresh Trick Shots
Aimed Shot on cooldown with Trick Shots up
opener: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on your primary target
Pre-cast Aimed Shot around 2.5 seconds before combat begins
Activate Trueshot alongside your Potion, on-use Trinket and Racial
Continue with the priority list (AoE opener: second Explosive Shot on a second target, Multi-Shot instead of Arcane Shot)

gear.gearing_rules: Agility > Crit > Mastery > Versatility > Haste (cheat sheet). Sim with Raidbots. The tier set makes spreading the two Unstable Trigger Explosive Shots optimal.

tier_set.name: Skulking Viper's Ambush
tier_set.pc2: Explosive Shot lasts 1.0 sec longer and deals 5% increased damage.
tier_set.pc4: Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire damage increased by 5%; each Explosive Shot burst reduces the cooldown of Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire by 0.5 sec.
tier_set.note: Optimal to spread the two Unstable Trigger Explosive Shots; otherwise no playstyle change.

Cuisses of the Uncoiled Union (The Coiled Altar)

notes: Crit is the safest secondary; sim for exact splits.

mplus.hero_note: Sentinel is optimal in M+ too; its smooth flow suits dungeon pacing.
tips: Explosive Shot's two Unstable Trigger casts should go on different targets in packs for double 4-set cooldown reduction.
Multi-Shot keeps Trick Shots up for Rapid Fire and Aimed Shot value in packs.
Hunter's Mark on the kill target at the start of every pull.
